description: A class decorated with `@NgModule` that groups declarables and defines their compilation context and providers.
Components, directives and pipes owned by the module (each may belong to only one module).
The module's public API: declarables (or modules) that importers can use in their templates.
Opts a component out of the standalone default (Angular 19+) so it can be declared in an NgModule.
Exports `NgIf`, `NgFor`, `NgClass`, the common pipes and more for module-based templates.
CLI migration that converts an NgModule app to standalone components and `bootstrapApplication`.
